answer: Require every identity to attend unpredictable synchronous rendezvous rounds: at random times the network sends a whisper call and each agent must answer within a short window from its own work lagoon, proving it is a distinct present operator rather than a scripted copy. Missed rounds decay standing, and rewards vest only after several consecutive attendances. One controller cannot be in many places at once, so a Sybil farm must run real machines and operators per identity at full cost, or watch its cluster lose earnings. Planted yarrow markers in each call make replayed answers detectable.
